title: Orecchiette with Rocket
description: A simple Italian pasta dish combining orecchiette pasta with fresh rocket, cherry tomatoes, garlic, and chili pepper in an olive oil-based sauce.
steps: Clean and wash the rocket thoroughly.
Cook rocket in plenty of salted water for 5 minutes.
Add orecchiette to the pot and continue cooking both together.
In a separate pan, heat oil with crushed garlic and chili pepper.
When garlic becomes golden, add halved cherry tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Combine cooked pasta and vegetables with the tomato mixture.
